metadata.dcterms:title: Constrained analysis of topologically massive gravity
metadata.dcterms:creator: Dargam, J. Barcelos-Neto ∗and T.G.
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We quantize the Einstein gravity in the formalism of weak gravitational ﬁelds by using the constrained Hamiltonian method. Special emphasis is given to the 2+1 spacetime dimensional case where a (topological) Chern-Simons term is added to the Lagrangian.
